claim_boundary: One FLUX.2 Klein 4B checkpoint, one seed, one prompt family, four steps, and 256x256 resolution.
The retokenized variant is a lexical proxy for a shared colour concept, not a proof of semantic equivalence.
A QKV branch is causal for the tested site/step suffix only; it is not a universal token mechanism.
Replication across seeds, prompt families, and checkpoints remains required.
interpretation.consumer_authority: Return-register alignment and native RGB closure are the route-effect authority; activation and QKV norms are local instruments.
interpretation.observation: The same lexical token is tested at two source roles, while token, position, tokenization, Q/K/V projection, site, timestep, and native consumer effects remain separately recorded.
